column1: # 正規表現は ERE。依頼は小文字化して照合する。条件なしは "-"
# 特定の評価問題の正解を書くのではなく、macOS の一般的な知識として正しい指摘にすること

column2: 削除|消|除去|捨て|掃除|片付|空に|remove|delete|clean|erase|wipe|prune|rm
column5: the request did not ask to delete anything; do not use rm or -delete
the request asks for a past date; "date -v +Nd" (or -v Nd) is a future date, use "date -v-Nd"
BSD date: put -v before the format, e.g. "date -v +3d +%Y-%m-%d"
the request did not ask to remove duplicates; use plain "sort" without -u

column1: ディレクトリ|フォルダ|directory|folder
column5: the request compares directories; use "diff -r dir1 dir2" for recursive comparison
docker ps -a includes stopped containers; the request asks for running ones, use "docker ps" without -a
the request mentions the Trash; on macOS it is at ~/.Trash
Xcode DerivedData is at ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData on macOS
on macOS /etc/resolv.conf does not show every resolver; use "scutil --dns" to show the DNS configuration
the request asks for the time of day; use a human-readable format like date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'
git shortlog --author needs an author name; to rank authors use "git shortlog -sn" without --author
the request asks to pretty-print the whole document; use "jq . file.json" instead of a field filter
the request asks to delay the action; use "sleep N && command" instead of backgrounding with &
the request asks to enter the directory; use "cd dir" (mv would move the files out of it)
the request asks for the most recent files; "tail" shows the oldest ones, use "head" after "ls -t"
use "vm_stat" (or "top -l 1") for memory usage, not sysctl

column1: (大きい|largest|biggest).*(ファイル|file)|(ファイル|file).*(大きい|largest|biggest)
column5: ls -lh | sort cannot sort human-readable sizes; use "ls -lS" (ls sorts by size natively)

column1: (ランキング|ranking|rank|多い順).*(著者|作者|author|contributor|コントリビューター)|(著者|作者|author|contributor|コントリビューター).*(ランキング|ranking|rank|多い順)
column5: to rank authors by commit count use "git shortlog -sn", not "git log"
git ls-files lists tracked files, not by modification time; use "ls -t | head -n N"

column1: スリープ.*(防止|させない|しない|止め)|(prevent|keep|stop).*(sleep|awake)
column5: to keep the Mac awake use "caffeinate" (e.g. "caffeinate -d" or "caffeinate -t SECONDS")
